listing.summary: Bring an ordinary ship to Path or Church shipwrights and have it rebuilt into a more sacred design.
listing.aiSummary: Lets you rebuild ordinary ships into sacred Luddic designs at Path or Church shipwrights.

description:
Bring an ordinary ship to Path or Church shipwrights and have it rebuilt into a more sacred design.

"Strip the comforts. Brace the mountings. The bones will serve."

Download 0.5.3

Features

Full coverage of vanilla donors and listed optional rosters, with 161 donor and destination combinations including compatible faction variants.
Donor markers identify suitable hulls. The target menu shows only designs with donors in your active fleet.
Immediate batch conversions with brief shipwright dialogue.
Removable weapons and fighter LPCs return to cargo. Story point hullmods are removed for bonus XP, without refunding story points.
D-mods, names, captains, flagship assignment, mothball status, and CR carry over.
For the Church retrofits that are purely cosmetic, practically all attributes and equipment stays consistent

Visit a Path market's bar with Favorable (+10) Path relations. Donate 25 supplies, 4 heavy armaments, or 10,000 credits per hull. At Friendly (+50) Path relations, the work is free.

Visit a Church market's bar with Neutral Church relations for livery, or Favorable (+10) Church relations for refits. Donate 5 supplies or 1,000 credits per hull for livery, or 10 supplies or 2,500 credits per hull for refits. At Friendly (+50) Church relations, the work is free.

Optional rosters
Luddic Enhancement, Luddic Enhancement IED, Ship/Weapon Pack, Hazard Mining Incorporated, Xxarra's Variety Pack, Knights of Ludd, JaydeePiracy, BigBeans ship compilation, and Everybody loves KoC.

IED tankers retain their Martyr systems and cannot be recovered if destroyed.

Also handles Nexerelin and uses RetroLib's Starship Legends reputation transfer.

Dependencies
Starsector 0.98a, RetroLib 1.1.1, LazyLib, and MagicLib.

Credits
This work relies on SafariJohn's RetroLib and is highly derivative of Roider Union. Roider Union itself is optional (but highly recommended!).

Changelog
0.5.3 - Added Luddic Church shipwright with separate handling for cosmetic retrofits and rebuilds. Added compatibility for BigBeans Ship Compilation. Added Vali (LP) compatibility from latest KoC update.
0.4.1 - Removed Luddic Church relation requirement
0.4.0 - Expanded variant handling (Hegemony, XIV, Lion's Guard, etc). Feedback is welcome if anything significant seems missing. Pirate variants still intentionally unsuitable. Rolled back excessive in-game mechanics description.
